numerics.method: positive atanh series plus geometric tail; exact integer floor/ceil per term
numerics.range: all input x>=1; binary range reduction y in[1,2), z in[0,1/3)
numerics.boundary: tight feasible => admit; relaxed negative cycle => reject; otherwise unknown, never forced

limitations: Actual upstream processor RTL translated by Yosys to CXXRTL and executed, with author-owned reference divider RTL, deterministic host memory, C firmware, and functional oracle. Digital discrete-event reference-design boundary only: no native Hopper/H20, physical clock, silicon, FPGA, PPA, latency/performance evidence, confidentiality, cryptography, necessity or inference resistance. Full debug intentionally reveals N/D. No remote experiment, publication, paper edit or scoring.
